name: manual_750ffa
claim: A newly acquired OS file lock proves only current lock availability, not that the prior owner died or downstream work ended; retain ambiguous effect state until independently reconciled.

decisions.notes: On macOS 27.2 arm64 with Python 3.13.18, a second process acquired flock after the first explicitly unlocked while still alive; see MAC_POSIX_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCK_BOUNDARIES_2026-11-10.md.
